summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on the current CipherBox branch, implementing any valid fixes and replying/resolving each thread.
summary.outcome: One unresolved CodeRabbit thread was found and addressed: removed a stale `*.ts` glob from `tsconfig.scripts.json` since all helpers in that directory are now `.mts` files. Changes were committed and pushed.

repo: All script helpers in the scripts directory have been migrated to `.mts`; no `.ts` files remain there, making the `*.ts` glob in tsconfig.scripts.json stale.
A targeted typecheck of scripts (not full `pnpm test`) is sufficient to verify tsconfig glob changes, avoiding RAM pressure from concurrent test suites.

code.finding: Contained a `*.ts` glob that no longer matched any files after migration to `.mts`; removed to keep tsconfig accurate.

workflow: Used `chore:` commit prefix instead of `fix:` for a JSON config-only cleanup to avoid triggering unnecessary version bumps.
Rebased before pushing to preserve any interleaved bot activity on the PR.
CodeRabbit bundles nitpick-level findings as inline thread comments (not review body), so GraphQL `reviewThreads` is the right query surface for these.
